evidence.code_proof: KdsV2Grid.vue:352-368 — .kds-v2__grid is `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); grid-template-rows: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 16px; padding: 16px;` with NO max-height nor responsive viewport-fit clamp.
evidence.media_query: Only @media (min-width: 2560px) bumps to 5 cols × 2 rows — at 1920x1080 the 4×2 grid is hard-coded.
evidence.math_confirmed: grid_top(164) + 2*row(462) + gap(16) + padding(32) = 1136px on 1080px viewport ⇒ 56px clipped. KdsOrderCard.vue has min-height ~440px on each card; bottom-row CTA (52px high Prêt button per template line 148-160) is below fold.
evidence.visual_proof: S3-R1-8orders-1920x1080-truncated.png INSPECTED — top row 4 cards full + visible CTA, bottom row 4 cards with item content visible but `Prêt` button row clipped at viewport bottom edge.
evidence.persona_chef_glance: 60-90cm chef cannot tap clipped CTA without page-scroll. Under rush, chef will either MISS that there are 4 more orders (no extra indication other than bottom card cutoff) OR slow down to scroll. Either is a production-real failure mode per owner mandate: 'le chef sous stress va sortir une commande incomplète'.

evidence.code_proof: KdsV2Grid.vue:55 `v-for="(o, idx) in activeOrders.slice(0, 8)"` — silent slice cap at 8. No overflow chip in template, no `+N hidden` indicator anywhere in the template lines 19-100.
evidence.data_path: activeOrders computed (line 177-182) filters to ACCEPT+PREPARING. If 9+ active orders exist, only the 8 OLDEST appear (FIFO sort line 162-173). Newer (≥9) silently hidden.
evidence.persona_chef_glance: Chef has zero visual cue that the queue exceeds 8. In a 19h-21h rush a 9th borne order can arrive in seconds. Customer waits, chef proceeds with visible queue → 9+ order goes cold or invisible until an existing slot frees. Owner mandate verbatim: 'chef devrait scroller parfois, il ferait pas attention il va sortir la commande pas complète'.

evidence.code_proof: KdsOrderCard.vue:571-585 — .kds-card__body has `overflow-y: auto` with thin scrollbar + 8px webkit + #6B7280 thumb. Wave U fix made scrollbar VISIBLE; it did NOT eliminate the scroll requirement.
evidence.fixed_card_height: KdsV2Grid sets card height via `grid-template-rows: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr))` ⇒ ~462px each at 1080px viewport. Header 110-130px + CTA 52px = ~280px usable body. ~5-6 items max visible without scroll.
evidence.persona_chef_glance: Long order (Sandwich Cayenne with 4 variations + crudités + supplements + sauces + notes = 12+ lines) overflows. Chef in rush relies on whole-card glance — scroll is a stop-the-line action incompatible with 5-10s glance budget. Owner verbatim: 'doivent scroller pour voir ou bien on affichera toute la commande affichée en une seule fois sans scroller'.

additional_blockers_found.title: Stock rupture mid-prep marker (`kdsInflight`) NOT wired into V2 grid/card — chef sees TOAST but no per-card badge identifying which active card holds the 86'd item
additional_blockers_found.scenario: Chef is preparing 6 orders during rush. Cashier marks 'Fromage Cheddar' as out-of-stock via /admin/stock-rupture-dashboard. Backend broadcasts `ItemAvailabilityChanged`. KitchenDisplaySystemComponent::_onItemAvailabilityChanged (line 2220-2256) fires `alertService.warning('Fromage Cheddar indisponible')` toast + `kdsInflight/markDeavailable` Vuex dispatch + `aria-live` polite announcement. Chef under rush, hands floured, gaze on grill — toast appears top-right for ~3-5s then disappears. Chef glances back at KDS grid: no per-card visual change. Which of the 6 in-flight tickets contained Cheddar? Chef must mentally cross-reference + scroll into cards.

evidence.source_grep: grep on KdsV2Grid.vue + KdsOrderCard.vue for `kdsInflight` / `kdsHasOosWarning` / `recentlyDeavailable` returns ZERO hits. The helper `kdsHasOosWarning(order)` is defined at KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:2265-2272 but is never imported into the V2 card path.
evidence.legacy_path_had_it: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:2728 references a per-card rupture warning in legacy 4-column template — when feature flag `kds.v2_enabled` is OFF (rollback path), card-level oos badge surfaces. V2 path does NOT.
evidence.vuex_module: store/modules/kdsInflight.js exists + 10-min TTL — backend wiring is complete; the V2 UI wire-up is the missing piece.

fix_options: A. Wire `kdsInflight/orderHasRecentlyDeavailableItem` into KdsOrderCard.vue as a prop or store-read; render a high-contrast red banner above the body 'STOCK 86 — vérifier composition' when true.
B. Add red border-left accent (4px solid #DC2626) on KdsOrderCard root when oos-flagged — minimal visual change, glance-instant.
C. Surface a chip in the meta row next to allergen pill: `🚫 STOCK 86`.
additional_blockers_found.persona_classification_rationale: Toast + aria-live + Vuex marker ARE present, so chef IS notified once. Rated FRICTION (not BLOCKER) per advisor reconciliation: chef is informed but the per-card glance regression vs legacy = hands-full chef can miss the transient toast and the active cards offer no visual differentiation.

additional_blockers_found.title: Allergen pill is generic 'ALLERGIE' — chef glance does NOT reveal which item / which allergen without scrolling into card body
additional_blockers_found.scenario: Chef glances at card C in a row of 8. Top-right corner shows `⚠ ALLERGIE` pill (KdsOrderCard.vue:48-54, orange #EA580C bg, role=alert, aria-live=assertive). Chef knows 'this order has an allergen somewhere'. To know WHICH item + WHICH allergen (e.g. gluten on the Cheddar burger but the customer also ordered fries), chef must scroll the body to find allergens_snapshot rendered per-item.

evidence.template_line: KdsOrderCard.vue:53 `⚠ {{ $t('label.kds_allergie') }}` — i18n key resolves to the generic word 'ALLERGIE'. Per-line allergen codes are inside .kds-card__body via `lines.push({ type: 'allergen', codes: allergenCodes })` (kdsCustomization.js:239) but they live BELOW the fold if items are ≥6 (compounds with S3-CHEF-003).
evidence.persona_chef_glance: 5-second glance is enough to KNOW there is an allergen; it is NOT enough to know which allergen + which item. Chef must either remember the customer warning at order placement (not possible via KDS-only flow) or scroll into the card body.

fix_options: A. Show the allergen codes inline on the pill: `⚠ ALLERGIE: GLUTEN, LACTOSE`. Cap to 3 codes + '+N' if more.
B. Move per-item allergen-snapshot rendering OUT of the scrolling body INTO a sticky banner zone above the card body (always visible regardless of card scroll position).
additional_blockers_found.persona_classification_rationale: Pill IS visible at glance — no hidden risk of missing 'there's an allergen'. The friction is on next-step granularity. Rated FRICTION (not BLOCKER) per advisor reconciliation.

additional_blockers_found.title: Kitchen printer offline status NOT surfaced on KDS — chef cannot know if their backup paper-trail is dead mid-rush
additional_blockers_found.scenario: Architecture has kitchen_hot / kitchen_cold / bar / receipt printer stations (PrinterRequest.php:38 enum). KDS is primary, paper is backup. If the kitchen_hot ESC/POS printer dies during rush (TCP drop, paper jam, USB unplugged), backend EscPosPrinterService catches the failure but the KDS UI has no surface for it. KdsStatusBanner banner priority (line 70: error > cap-full > cap-warning > fallback > sync > bump-notice) does NOT include any printer status branch. The chef discovers paper failure only later (no fallback receipt for customer dispute resolution).

evidence.kds_banner_priority_grep: KdsStatusBanner.vue:68-122 — bannerData computed iterates: offlineSince, listAtCap, nearCap≥200, fallbackMode, adminPollingHint, bumpLocalOnlyNotice. No printer signal.
evidence.kiosk_HAS_it: Kiosk side has printer-failure surface (KioskConfirmationComponent.vue:44 'kiosk.confirmation.print_failed', kioskPrinter.js:266 reportPrinterFailure → /api/hardware/log). KDS side does NOT have a parallel surface.
evidence.broadcast_grep: No `KitchenPrinterOffline` event broadcast anywhere in the codebase. Printer.php `status` field exists but no Echo handler in KDS subscribes to printer-status changes.

fix_options: A. Add 4th banner level 'printer-warning' between fallback and sync; pull kitchen_hot printer.status from admin/printers feed or a new Echo channel.
B. Defer if owner V1 mandate is 'KDS is the only kitchen surface, paper printer is optional' (then INFO not FRICTION).
additional_blockers_found.persona_classification_rationale: Per advisor: rate FRICTION (not BLOCKER) UNLESS owner has stated paper printing is primary. In V1 Le Cayenne, KDS is primary — paper printers are a backup convenience. Chef won't make a wrong-order mistake from this (KDS still shows the order); the friction is on customer-dispute and physical-routing convenience. PENDING OWNER CLARIFICATION.

additional_blockers_found.persona_classification_rationale: Historique drawer (Wave X3) provides full-day fallback. Rated INFO not FRICTION because the recovery path is one click.
